objective: perform exactly one outcome attachment to the already-frozen non-identity v2.9 policy and evaluate it without tuning against both preregistered comparators

run_preconditions: HEAD is the supplied implementation commit
the supplied protocol commit is the direct parent of HEAD
the protocol commit is the direct child of the Stage1b evidence commit
HEAD equals both the supplied implementation commit and the branch upstream tip; the supplied protocol commit is HEAD^ and is therefore reachable from that tip
the tracked working tree is clean
the protocol and implementation commits changed exactly their allowlisted paths
checkpoint_choreography.implementation_binding: the exact clean pushed implementation commit, its direct-parent relation, its two-path diff allowlist, and its source hash recorded before label access replace a third pre-outcome manifest commit

proposal_union_inputs.loaded_arrays: for each outer fold, first-pass held session_ordinal plus frozen Stage1a held_H candidates, available, current_chosen, and current_activation
proposal_union_inputs.repeat_use: repeat arrays are not loaded; their exact equality is inherited only after both frozen result identities and manifests revalidate
required_checks: five held session ordinals are disjoint, sorted, each size 400, and cover 0..1999 exactly
each candidate and available array matches its result-registered path, file hash, logical hash, shape, and dtype
available candidates are in 0..99 and unavailable candidates are -1
the stitched domain-local current arrays equal the held current arrays registered by Stage1a
no proposal score is reconstructed and no family, depth, threshold, or fold is selected after outcome

supplement_contract.source: the five first-pass Stage1b outer supplement arrays registered in the frozen Stage1b result
supplement_contract.purpose: report incremental selector behavior only; policy outcome always uses the complete frozen final chosen and activation arrays

physical_input_audit.path_requirements: every source, manifest, result, policy, proposal, supplement, feature, score, and label input is a regular non-symlink file at its exact pinned path
physical_input_audit.label_archive_handle: open exactly one binary handle; hash and size-check that handle, create the fixed xb one-shot result receipt, seek the same label handle to zero, pass that same handle to the only np.load call, close the NPZ view without closing/replacing the handle, then seek and hash the same handle again
physical_input_audit.target_free_inputs: record start and end file SHA256 and bytes for every input that remains in memory or memory-mapped during the attach; both observations must equal the pinned registry

frozen_global_comparator_reconstruction.reason: no provenance-bound materialized global activation/chosen pair exists; aggregate historical metrics cannot support per-session transition and per-fold gates
frozen_global_comparator_reconstruction.algorithm: an operation-equivalent row-isolated implementation of the pinned ActionSurface plus _reproduce_nested_activation semantics; do not call the historical run function or broad _load_inputs helper
frozen_global_comparator_reconstruction.target_free_preopen_phase: derive and hash-gate incumbent, chosen, action, and gate features before the archive open; attach rescue/regret labels only after the one-shot semantic open
frozen_global_comparator_reconstruction.held_privacy: for outer o, derive rescue/regret arrays only for T_o, perform every fit and quantile selection only on T_o, and use H_o gate features for prediction only
frozen_global_comparator_reconstruction.fit_count_derivation: 5 outer folds * 5 inner folds * 2 heads plus 5 outer full-T fits * 2 heads

metric_contract.official_state: protected baseline ranks 1..9 are immutable; otherwise an activated correct candidate has rank 10 and an activated wrong candidate has rank 0; eligibility begins at eligible_from; first hit determines reciprocal rank and turn; miss turn is 11

unrounded_gate_arithmetic.method: exact rational sums over integer first ranks and first turns
unrounded_gate_arithmetic.floating_tolerance: diagnostic parity only and never promotion

metric_contract.masks: aggregate 2000 sessions plus five fixed 400-session held outer folds
comparisons_in_order: frozen global current baseline versus domain-local current challenger drift
metric_contract.drift_report: aggregate plus five folds of global-miss-to-domain-hit, global-hit-to-domain-miss, net hits, HR, MRR, MTTC, and TechnicalScore deltas; drift is descriptive and never enters the proposal oracle or promotion gate

posthoc_proposal_union_report.surface: the frozen first-pass held_H available/candidates arrays; no score reconstruction, refill, rerank, family selection, or depth selection
posthoc_proposal_union_report.frozen_global_surface_rule: use the exact same supplemental-only held_H available/candidates union and replace only the comparator miss mask; do not add the domain-local served choice or fallback, and do not rebuild exclusion or refill relative to the frozen-global comparator
posthoc_proposal_union_report.correct_turn: available and turn+1>=eligible_from and positive_index>=0 and candidate==positive_index
posthoc_proposal_union_report.reachable_session: comparator is currently a miss and at least one correct_turn exists
report: current hits and misses aggregate and by outer fold
correct action rows on current misses
reachable sessions aggregate and by outer fold
maximum zero-harm ceiling hits and HR@10
whether frozen-global reachable sessions are at least 37

candidate_recall_reused_from_tracked_v2_.C200: unavailable in the frozen blind trace and not inferred

fail_closed_invariants: correct_action_rows are counted only under that comparator's current-miss mask
sum of misses_by_outer_fold equals aggregate misses
sum of reachable_by_outer_fold equals aggregate reachable
reachable_sessions is no greater than current misses
frozen-global reachable_sessions is no greater than 43
frozen-global ceiling_hr_at_10 is no greater than 0.993
posthoc_proposal_union_report.capacity_interpretation: frozen-global reachable_sessions>=37 is proposal capacity only; it neither proves the final policy reached 0.99 nor enters promotion
posthoc_proposal_union_report.oracle_exception_behavior: REPORT_ONLY_UNAVAILABLE; the already-frozen strict decision and consumed one-shot receipt remain unchanged

execution_and_output.one_shot_receipt: after every preflight and the label archive physical hash pass, create the fixed output path with mode xb and keep that same handle open; its existence blocks every later semantic attach, and on success the single canonical JSON is written through that handle

decision_rules.mechanical_failure_before_receipt: BLOCKED_NO_OUTCOME_CONSUMED; repair only the preregistered mechanic
decision_rules.failure_after_receipt_or_semantic_open_b: INVALID_STAGE2_ONE_SHOT_CONSUMED; do not rerun, do not tune, and do not call it an algorithm No-Go
decision_rules.outcome_no_go: close the exact k=5 route; do not change depth, refill, features, models, weights, utility, quantiles, threshold, latch, or fold enablement
decision_rules.outcome_promote: authorize only a full-data artifact freeze plus target-free parity and resource benchmark
decision_rules.regardless_of_result: do not open calibration, selection, confirmation, released public, Amazon, private-shaped labels, Agent, or official evaluator
